# Environment client scripts against a fixture server. Counts of create and
# exec calls are checked by TestEnvironmentScripts.

# Invalid input is refused before any request.
! skygo env plan -f unknown.yaml
stderr 'field color not found'
! stdout .
! skygo env create -f null.yaml --request-id req-0 --request-domain $DOMAIN
stderr 'must not contain null'
! stderr 'request-id:'
! skygo env create -f port.yaml
stderr 'port must be 0 or 8080'
! stderr 'request-id:'
! skygo env create -f plain.yaml --request-id 'bad id' --request-domain $DOMAIN
stderr 'request ID requires'
# A request ID is a retry and needs its original domain.
! skygo env create -f plain.yaml --request-id req-1
stderr 'given together'
! stderr 'request-id:'

# Plan creates nothing. Without artifacts the fact does not apply, and it is
# never shown as verified.
skygo env plan -f plain.yaml
stdout '^spec-sha256: [0-9a-f]{64}$'
stdout '^support: supported$'
stdout '^artifacts: not-applicable$'
! stderr .

# Artifact mounts need the target's artifacts capability.
! skygo env plan -f mounted.yaml
stderr 'target "kube" does not advertise environment-artifacts-v1'
skygo env plan -f mounted-art.yaml
stdout '^artifacts: unknown$'

# A plan whose fact contradicts the spec is refused.
! skygo env plan -f liar.yaml
stderr 'inconsistent artifacts fact'

# Create prints its request domain and ID first. The same pair and spec
# replays the same environment; the same pair with another spec is refused
# and not retried.
skygo env create -f plain.yaml --request-id req-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN
stderr '^request-domain: '$DOMAIN'$'
stderr '^request-id: req-1$'
stdout '^0{31}1 +analysis +kube +present +creating +0 +0$'
skygo env create -f plain.yaml --request-id req-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN
stdout '^0{31}1 +analysis'
! skygo env create -f other.yaml --request-id req-1 --request-domain $DOMAIN
stderr 'retry with --request-domain '$DOMAIN' --request-id req-1'
stderr 'already_exists'

# A new request samples the current domain once and picks a fresh ID.
skygo env create -f other.yaml
stderr '^request-domain: '$DOMAIN'$'
stderr '^request-id: [0-9a-f]{32}$'
stdout '^0{31}2 +other'

skygo env get 00000000000000000000000000000001
stdout 'analysis +kube +present +creating'
skygo --json env get 00000000000000000000000000000001
stdout '"phase": *"ENVIRONMENT_PHASE_CREATING"'

# An undeclared enum value from the server is refused, not printed.
! skygo env get 22222222222222222222222222222222
stderr 'unknown fields or enum values'
! stdout .

# Deletion needs confirmation.
! skygo env delete 00000000000000000000000000000001
stderr 'deletion requires --yes'

# Exec runs one command; without --stdin it sends no stdin.
skygo env exec 00000000000000000000000000000001 -- echo hi
stdout '^echo hi$'
! stderr .
# A command whose exit status was not relayed is reported unknown and is not
# resent. A nonzero status fails. JSON output keeps both outcomes.
! skygo env exec 00000000000000000000000000000001 -- lost
stderr 'command outcome unknown; it was not resent'
! skygo --json env exec 00000000000000000000000000000001 -- lost
stdout '^\{\}$'
stderr 'command outcome unknown; it was not resent'
! skygo env exec 00000000000000000000000000000001 -- fail
stdout '^fail$'
stderr 'command exited with status 3'
! skygo --json env exec 00000000000000000000000000000001 -- fail
stdout '"exit_code": *3'
stderr 'command exited with status 3'
! skygo env exec 00000000000000000000000000000001 echo
stderr 'exec requires ID -- ARGV'

-- plain.yaml --
name: analysis
target: kube
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
-- other.yaml --
name: other
target: kube
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
-- unknown.yaml --
name: analysis
target: kube
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
color: blue
-- null.yaml --
name: analysis
target: kube
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
storage_alias: null
-- port.yaml --
name: analysis
target: kube
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
port: 22
-- mounted.yaml --
name: analysis
target: kube
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
artifacts:
  - id: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
    sha256: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
    size: 1
    mount_path: /skygo/artifacts/input
-- mounted-art.yaml --
name: analysis
target: kube-art
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
artifacts:
  - id: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
    sha256: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
    size: 1
    mount_path: /skygo/artifacts/input
-- liar.yaml --
name: analysis
target: liar
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 500
memory_bytes: 1073741824
